verdict.rationale: cubic's own coding agent can generate fixes for issues found in its code review and push them to the PR branch ('Fix with cubic'). That covers a narrow slice of the story, roughly fixing flagged code-quality or standards issues. No evidence shows it writing tests, resolving merge conflicts, or updating dependencies. Missing for 10: test generation, explicit lint-error fixing, merge-conflict resolution, dependency updates, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies for me

citations.quote: cubic can automatically fix issues identified during code review. Request a targeted fix with one click.
cubic generates the fix and pushes it to your PR branch.
By default, cubic pushes commits directly to your PR branch.
